title: LangChain Open Sources Content Studio Agent Used to Generate 3,000 Assets
summary:
The artificial intelligence company has made its internal content creation engine available to the public under an open-source license. The software, called Content Studio, operates within Slack to produce marketing materials such as slide decks, ad creatives and UI mockups, while utilizing HyperFrames for code-based video editing and Paper for collaborative storyboarding.

LangChain used the agent to generate more than 3,000 internal corporate assets, including a film for the tool's own launch, prior to its release. Developers can now fork the agent's codebase and apply custom brand guidelines to deploy the system to their own teams using Managed Deep Agents.
